SUPERIOR COURT OF CALIFORNIA, COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES
Civil Division
North District, Michael D. Antonovich Antelope Valley Courthouse, Department A03
26AVSC00192 May 22, 2026

NICOLAS HERNANDEZ vs LOCAL INITIATIVE HEALTH 3:12 PM
AUTHORITY OF LOS ANGELES COUNTY

Commissioner: Honorable Robert J. Palazzolo © CSR: None

Judicial Assistant: Z. Loeser ERM: None
Courtroom Assistant: None Deputy Sheriff: None
APPEARANCES:

For Plaintiff(s): No Appearances
For Defendant(s): No Appearances

NATURE OF PROCEEDINGS: Ruling on Submitted Matter

The Court, having taken the matter under submission on 05/21/2026 for Non-Jury Trial, now
rules as follows:

The Court finds that the Plaintiff has not yet exhausted all appropriate administrative remedies
pursuant to Government Code section 905. This case is dismissed without prejudice.

The Court orders the Amended Plaintiff's Claim (1st) filed by Nicolas Hernandez on 03/20/2026
dismissed Without Prejudice.

Clerk to give notice.

Certificate of Mailing is attached.

This leaves the door open to filing again. When a case is dismissed "without prejudice" it essentially
means that the case never happened and that the same that the same claim can be brought again in
asubsequent action, as there has been no final adjudication on the merits of the controversy.

The Commissioner was very fair on this case - taking it into submission shows that he recognized the
true depth of the case and did not dismiss it on the spot to clear the queue.

Enter the Tort Claim (Government Code section 905)...
